name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,531 on 20 Nov, down 8.4% on the week, past the 7% Alert line, as Fed rate-rise bets lift the dollar
state: Gold futures were near $3,531 at 17:30 UTC on 20 Nov, 8.4% lower on the week and 24.8% lower over three months, about a third below the 52-week high of $5,318 (Yahoo Finance). The weekly fall is back beyond the 7% single-week Alert line. Gold fell to a 14-month low near $3,760 on 18 Nov (Mitrade) and dropped to over one-year lows as hawkish Fed signals boosted the dollar (New Straits Times).
for_you: Gold is moving unusually fast. Holders of gold and gold funds are exposed to large price swings while rate expectations shift.

sources.title: Mitrade — Gold falls to a 14-month low near $3,760
New Straits Times — Gold drops 2pct to over one-year low as hawkish Fed signals boost dollar

why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
